base_url.correction: No single base URL: US public endpoints use https://us.i.posthog.com and private endpoints use https://us.posthog.com; EU equivalents are https://eu.i.posthog.com and https://eu.posthog.com.

free_tier_limits.correction: Published monthly limits include 1M analytics events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature-flag requests, 100K exceptions, 1,500 survey responses, and additional product-specific allowances.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include: analytics 240/min and 1,200/hour; events/values 60/min and 300/hour; query 2,400/hour; feature-flag local evaluation 600/min; other CRUD endpoints 480/min and 4,800/hour. Public capture and flag-evaluation endpoints have no request-level limit.

example.correction: curl -L --header "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"api_key":"<ph_project_token>","event":"event name","distinct_id":"user distinct id"}' https://us.i.posthog.com/i/v0/e/

notes: PostHog and its API are operational. The entry conflates public ingestion and private API hosts: /api/projects/ is a private GET request and cannot be called unauthenticated on us.i.posthog.com. Pricing limits and API rate limits are explicitly published, contradicting both unknown/not-published claims. No authoritative general CORS policy was located.
